> It is still (the end of) your minion phase. The incoming Tupdog is burned.

Mind you, there still might be a use to this in an all-Tupdog crypt:

Tupdog-A with a skill card and the Soul Gem burns.
A new minion (Tupdog-C) is placed into your uncontrolled region per
Tupdog-A text.
Per Soul Gem text, you also take the top minion off your crypt (look,
Tupdog-B - lower capacity!) and put them into play with the Soul Gem.
Tupdog-B burns because it's still the end of your minion phase.
A new minion (Tupdog-D) is placed into your uncontrolled region per
Tupdog-B text.
Per Soul Gem text, you also take the top minion off your crypt (look,
Tupdog-E - same capacity as B) and put them into your uncontrolled
region, burning the Soul Gem per its text.

So when your minion phase ended, you had a Tupdog with a skill card and
the Soul Gem.
When you're done resolving the Soul Gem/Tupdog chain, the Soul Gem and
skill card are in your ash heap, as is the Tupdog you started with -
and one more Tupdog is in your ash heap, but THREE new minions are in
your uncontrolled region.

Which might potentially be useful to do sometime.
